description: Shared HTTP/JSON service-operation catalog for the Lab 4 Gateway baseline. The receiving owner defines each operation's method, path, schemas, errors, authorization and idempotency. Callers send every operation to the Gateway; the Gateway authenticates the caller with its own credential, enforces the operation's caller allowlist, replaces the credential with the target's credential, adds X-Service-Name and forwards the same path. This is temporary HTTP transport, not RabbitMQ or Message Broker delivery.

transport.callerSends: POST|GET <GATEWAY_URL><path> with Authorization: Bearer <caller credential> and X-Trace-Id
transport.gatewayForwards: the same method and path to one Discovery-selected target instance, with Authorization: Bearer <target credential> and X-Service-Name: <authenticated caller>
transport.credentials: Every caller and every target has its own secret of 32-256 visible ASCII characters. No universal service token, no Discovery-token reuse, no player JWT on service routes. Secrets live only in deployment environments, never in Git.
transport.noGenericForwarding: The Gateway routes only the paths listed here; any other /internal path is 404. No caller-chosen target URL.
transport.identity: Public REST: the Gateway sets X-Player-Id from the verified access-JWT subject and discards any client value. Service operations carry no player identity header; player ids are body fields that the receiving owner authorizes.
transport.trace: X-Trace-Id is preserved on every hop and echoed on every response.

budgetsMs.note: Membership budgets remain fixed. Generation/readiness and durable callbacks may declare explicit per-operation budgets; fit child calls inside parent deadlines.

gatewayErrors.403 CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED: authenticated caller is not on the operation allowlist
gatewayErrors.404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: path is not a catalog operation
gatewayErrors.504 TASK_TIMEOUT: the 750 ms Gateway budget was exceeded

statusLegend.candidate: defined by the receiving owner in an open PR; not merged or released
statusLegend.implemented-pending-review: implemented by the receiving owner on a feature branch with tests; not merged or released
statusLegend.requested: exact dependency contract published by a caller; the receiving owner has not accepted or implemented it
statusLegend.owner-to-define: needed operation whose contract only its owner can define

callerNotes.moderation-service: requested addition to the Gateway allowlist; Moderation checks the MODERATOR role before reading any answer key

operations.idempotency: read-only
operations.retry: never retried by callers

errors.503: database failure; never a permission denial

operations.semantics: 200 with member=false and empty role/arrays for unknown sessions, non-members, unassigned players and completed sessions. Membership comes only from persisted Session assignments.

operations.name: session.applyScoreChange
operations.idempotency: scoreChangeId: the same id with identical content applies at most once and returns applied=false with the current score; the same id with different content is 409 SCORE_CHANGE_CONFLICT
operations.retry: the caller's outbox may resend the identical stored body after an outage, a deadline or a restart
operations.semantics: The only score/penalty mutation. reason DECISION, APPEAL_REFUND or DECISION_VOID; a decision causes at most one change of each reason. Session must not score DecisionRecorded again. New changes require ACTIVE state and the stored MODERATOR. Retries are recognized after completion. Adjustment reasons change score/penalties only; recorded correctness is historical and is not inferred from a refund/void. Post-completion result changes are forbidden.
operations.statusEvidence: Receiver accepts the proposed operation; implementation under Session issue25, not merged or released.

operations.name: session.decisionRecorded
operations.idempotency: eventId: identical repeat is 200 DUPLICATE with no effect; different content is 409 EVENT_CONFLICT
operations.retry: outbox; delivered only after the decision's score change was applied
operations.semantics: Advances the queue and counts the decision. It never applies a score (session.applyScoreChange already did) and is never republished.
operations.statusEvidence: Receiver accepts the proposed operation; implementation under Session issue25, not merged or released.

operations.name: rules.evaluate
operations.idempotency: no side effects
operations.retry: never retried by the caller
operations.semantics: Authoritative violations for the session's ruleset. Rules obtains the facts it needs with its own service identity (record facts below, moderation.applicantDecisionFacts), never by impersonating a player.

operations.name: moderation.applicantDecisionFacts
operations.statusEvidence: m3ower/student-id-moderation-service issue #30
operations.idempotency: read-only
operations.retry: caller's choice; no side effects
operations.semantics: Moderation's own recorded decisions about an applicant for a prior-ban check. Read-only; never evaluates or calls another service, so it cannot recurse into rules.evaluate. Returns no expected action, violations or correctness.

operations.name: dms.shiftStarted
operations.statusEvidence: m3ower/student-id-discord-dms-service issue #33
operations.idempotency: eventId with a persisted content digest: identical repeat 200 DUPLICATE, different content 409 EVENT_CONFLICT; an interrupted delivery is re-processed with deterministic effects
operations.retry: producer may resend the identical envelope

errors.400 MALFORMED_REQUEST: not an envelope, or unknown top-level field
errors.403 PRODUCER_MISMATCH: envelope.producer is not the authenticated caller

operations.semantics: Creates the four default channels and one announcement in #general-mod-chat; 200 only after both are stored in Redis.

operations.idempotency: as dms.shiftStarted
operations.retry: producer outbox resends the identical envelope

errors.409 SESSION_CHAT_NOT_INITIALIZED: ShiftStarted not processed yet; not acknowledged, resend later

operations.semantics: Posts one announcement in #general-mod-chat and fans it out across replicas. Never scores and never republishes.

operations.name: rules.selectForSession
operations.idempotency: Select/freeze a persisted ruleset for a real session; repeated session selection must return the same version.
operations.retry: Receiver must define idempotency; no in-request retry.
operations.semantics: Exact dependency DTO supplied by Session. Rules owner must publish the canonical service-only method/path; public user current-rules read is not a substitute. Session does not invent a peer endpoint or hardcode version1.
